imu.provenance: Registers match balance_lqr.cpp. MPU-6500 Register Map rev2.1 pp12-15 and Product Specification rev1.1 pp9-10 in bundled Datasheet/Sensor. DLPF approximated by first-order lowpass plus fractional delay matching low-frequency group delay; not exact proprietary filter. Register map gives accel noise 220 ug/sqrtHz; product spec gives 300 ug/sqrtHz under its conditions. Biases set to zero until measured. No thermal drift, I2C latency/jitter or DMP/magnetometer. Site pose remains existing CAD approximation.

encoder.provenance: 11 PPR is a provisional ASLONG JGB37-520B manufacturer reference, NOT verified on actual motors. FPGA motor_measure counts XOR(A,B) transitions (x4), saturates at 0/65535; output remains wheel-relative rad/rad_s after reduction. Opposite raw signs emulate documented SX/DX mounting; model joint sign remains +X for both. No missing pulses, backlash, A/B electrical waveform or FPGA input-filter latency simulated. Active bitstream and actual wheel CPR still need confirmation. Raw names now refer to physical left/right, with joint-to-counter signs [+1,-1], matching wheel map v2. Decoded joint angles are unchanged.
